caseName: Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc.
caseNameFull: Vermont Yankee Nuclear Power Corp. v. Natural Resources Defense Council, Inc. and Consumers Power Co. v. Aeschliman

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. Motion of Edison Electric Institute et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of the motion and petitions.
